question: How does reflective awareness of worldly fear arise in the heart through the descent of power?
premises: Fear of worldly existence can produce a trembling touch in the heart.
From that touch reflective awareness of the fear of becoming can arise.
This manifestation occurs through the descent of power.
inference: Even a fear-born stirring in the heart can become liberating reflective awareness when empowered by śaktipāta.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of yena is slightly open without the following verse.
plain_english: Even from a trembling touch born of fear of worldly existence, a reflective awareness of the fear of becoming can arise in the heart and become manifest through the descent of power.
